## 6 MDR collection partitioning

### 6.1 Prepare data

Builds the collection-specific subset and the metadata used to compare clinical syndrome and reservoir collections.

```{r 6_1_prepare_data}

species_category <- read.csv(
  "data/species_category.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    species = short_species_label(species)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

species_category <- species_category %>%
  dplyr::select(-eskape, -who)

category_cols <- names(species_category)[
  !names(species_category) %in% "species" &
    !grepl("_conf$", names(species_category))
]

species_collections <- purrr::map_dfr(
  category_cols,
  \(category) species_category %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data[[category]] == 2,
      .data[[paste0(category, "_conf")]] == "High"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      species,
      collection = category
    )
)

collection_mode_dist <- species_mdr_draws %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    species_collections,
    by = "species"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    collection,
    year,
    draw_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    modal_resistant_count = {
      tab <- table(resistant_count)
      max(as.integer(names(tab)[tab == max(tab)]))
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    collection,
    year,
    modal_resistant_count,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    collection,
    year,
    modal_resistant_count = 0:length(ab_list),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(collection, year) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(freq = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# ============================================================
# Plotting metadata
# ============================================================

clinical_cols <- c(
  "urogenital",
  "enteric",
  "skin_soft_tissue",
  "respiratory",
  "invasive_systemic"
)

reservoir_cols <- c(
  "healthcare",
  "environmental",
  "foodborne",
  "human_commensal",
  "zoonotic",
  "livestock"
)

collection_order <- c(clinical_cols, reservoir_cols)

collection_labels <- c(
  healthcare = "Healthcare",
  urogenital = "Urogenital",
  enteric = "Enteric",
  skin_soft_tissue = "Skin / soft tissue",
  respiratory = "Respiratory",
  invasive_systemic = "Invasive / systemic",
  environmental = "Environmental",
  foodborne = "Foodborne",
  human_commensal = "Human commensal",
  zoonotic = "Zoonotic",
  livestock = "Livestock"
)

collection_pattern_data <- collection_mode_dist %>%
  dplyr::filter(collection %in% collection_order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    collection_type = dplyr::if_else(
      collection %in% clinical_cols,
      "Clinical syndromes",
      "Reservoirs"
    ),
    collection_type = factor(
      collection_type,
      levels = c("Clinical syndromes", "Reservoirs")
    ),
    collection_label = factor(
      unname(collection_labels[collection]),
      levels = unname(collection_labels[collection_order])
    ),
    modal_resistant_count = factor(
      modal_resistant_count,
      levels = 0:length(ab_list)
    ),
    year = as.integer(year)
  )

collection_mdr_cols <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#870101"))(14)
names(collection_mdr_cols) <- as.character(0:13)

make_collection_plot <- function(dat, type_label) {
  
  ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = freq,
      fill = modal_resistant_count
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 1, colour = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~ collection_label, ncol = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = collection_mdr_cols,
      limits = as.character(0:13),
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "",
      guide = guide_legend(
        nrow = 2,
        byrow = TRUE,
        keywidth = unit(0.45, "cm"),
        keyheight = unit(0.35, "cm")
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(1990, 2023, 5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "Distribution of resistance classes"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```
